keep_slower_than_ms.description: Keep every trace whose slowest span is at least this long, regardless of `rate`.

rate.description: Share of traces the head rule keeps, 0 to 1.

shift_ns.description: Nanoseconds to add to the span's start so it sits inside its parent (duration unchanged).

ack_min.description: Minutes after declaration by which the incident must leave triage.

update_every_min.description: Minutes between updates while the incident is open.

oneOf.description:
Two counts over the window. A `PromQL` query is an instant query at the window end that may
use `$window`; its series are summed. `LogCount` counts matching log rows.

request_ratio.description:
Two counts over the window. A `PromQL` query is an instant query at the window end that may
use `$window`; its series are summed. `LogCount` counts matching log rows.

oneOf.description:
Requests of a service (one endpoint, or all when empty) at or under `threshold_ms`, from
the RED rollups.

latency.description:
Requests of a service (one endpoint, or all when empty) at or under `threshold_ms`, from
the RED rollups.

oneOf.description: Uptime-monitor results that are up; maintenance results are not counted.

availability.description: Uptime-monitor results that are up; maintenance results are not counted.

oneOf.description:
Slices of `slice_s` seconds in which `query op threshold` holds (a range query stepped by
`slice_s`; with several series, every one must hold).

window_based.description:
Slices of `slice_s` seconds in which `query op threshold` holds (a range query stepped by
`slice_s`; with several series, every one must hold).

Sli.description: What counts as good and total events.

SloBurn.description:
The query of a managed `slo_burn` rule: 1 while the tier's multiwindow condition holds, else 0.
The SLO itself (objective, SLIs, corrections) is loaded when the rule is evaluated.

page_rule_id.description: The managed alert rules (`slo_burn`) for the page and ticket tiers.

SloSpec.description:
Everything about an SLO that a user sets. Give `sli` for a request or window SLO, or
`children` for a composite (the weighted mean of its children's good ratios).

children.description: Composite only: 1 to 10 non-composite SLOs of this project, each in its own environment.

service.description: Catalog service the SLO belongs to.

or 30000 ms (422 otherwise); `window_based` slices are 60 to 300 s.

incomplete.description: The parent span is not in this trace (dropped, sampled out or not yet arrived).

parent_span_id.description: All zeros for a root span.
All zeros for a root span.

fingerprints.description:
Fingerprints (64 hex chars, from `…/fingerprints`) that move to a new issue. The issue
keeps at least one.

template_id.description:

subscriber.description: One of `{"receiver": id}`, `{"team": slug}`, `{"user": id}` or `{"email": address}`.

email.description: An address (at most 254 characters). Recorded only: there is no email delivery yet.

team.description: A team slug with a default receiver; the update goes to that receiver.

user.description: A project member. Recorded only: there is no per-user delivery yet.

events.description:
1 to 30 of an event type, `alert.*` style groups (`alert`, `issue`, `incident`,
`deployment`, `monitor`) or `*`.

receiver_id.description: A `webhook` receiver of the project; deliveries are signed and retried like alerts.

evidence.description:
Always `same_service_time_window_inferred`: the alert's `service` label is one of the
incident's services and the incident was active within 30 minutes of the alert.

author_email.description: The commit author, a candidate to ask or assign.

evidence.description:
Always `commit_touched_frame_file`: the commit touched a file in the stack. It is evidence,
not a finding that the commit caused the error.

score.description: Sum over in-app frames of 1 / frame depth for frames whose file the commit touched.

data.description: At most 3, best first. Empty when the issue's first release has no stored commits.

monitor_ids.description: `mon_...` ids of this project; replaces the tag's monitors.

version.description: Starts at 1; goes up when the body changes.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters, unique in the project.

event_type.description: One of the trigger event types.

payload.description: A sample event payload (at most 64 KiB).

notification_id.description: The queued notification; follow it in `GET /notifications`.

issue_id.description: `iss_…` id of the issue that owns the events now.

users.description: Upper bound: users seen under several fingerprints of the issue count once per fingerprint.

TraceSummary.description: Whole-trace facts, computed once (first page only).

critical_path.description: Span ids on the critical path, ordered by start time.

partial.description:
The trace has more spans than the summary reads: `critical_path` is empty and the
sampling and error figures are not computed.

sample_rate.description: Lowest `wt.sample_rate` of any span (1.0 = every trace kept); absent when unsampled.

sampled.description: `sample_rate < 1`: the trace stands for more traces than were kept.

limit.description: Traces returned, 1 to 100 (default 20). Totals still count every match.

q.description:
A spanset query such as `{ resource.service.name = "checkout" } >> { status = error }`
or a funnel such as `funnel({ name = "cart" }, { name = "pay" })`.

matched_traces.description: All matching traces among the candidates read (a search).

when it is complete.

scanned_traces.description: Candidate traces whose spans were read.

steps.description: One entry per funnel step (empty for a search).

truncated.description: More candidates (10,000) or spans (300,000) existed than were read: counts are lower bounds.

apdex.description: `None` for an empty bucket; filled in after the query.
Apdex over the whole range; null when no span matched.

apdex_t_ms.description: Apdex threshold T used, in milliseconds.

fields.description: Form values to set in the same step (so required fields can be filled while resolving).

note.description: Shown on the timeline row, at most 2000 characters.

status.description: The new status. `closed` only follows `resolved`; `closed` is final.

entry_id.description: The timeline entry of the update.

queued.description: Receivers the update was queued for.

skipped.description: Subscribers recorded but not delivered to (users and emails).

bytes.description: Approximate stored bytes (text fields and attributes).

selection.description: Share of the selection's rows with this value (0..=1).

tz.description: IANA zone the rule is evaluated in (default `UTC`).

matchers.description: Alerts whose labels match all of these are muted (mode `mute`).

slos.description: SLO ids, excluded from burn while the window runs (R3).

owner_id.description: The user its actions run as: whoever saved it last.

name.description: 1 to 100 characters, unique in the project.

steps.description:
1 to 50 steps. Actions: `send_notification`, `http_request`, `create_incident`,
`update_incident`, `add_timeline_note`, `page`, `create_jira_issue`, `create_slack_channel`,
`post_slack_message`, `run_query`, `start_postmortem`, `wait` (`seconds` 1 to 900) and
`trigger_workflow` (chains at most 3 deep). `${$.json.path}` in a string parameter is
replaced from the event payload. The caller needs the permission of every action.

trigger.description:
`events` (1 to 20 of `alert.{firing,resolved,acknowledged}`, `issue.{created,regressed,
resolved,assigned}`, `incident.{declared,status_changed,severity_changed,field_changed,
resolved}`, `deployment.created`, `monitor.{down,up}`) and optional `conditions`: an
expression of `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `contains`, `startsWith`, `matches` (RE2), `and`, `or` and
`not` over `JSONPath` into the event payload (at most 4 KiB, 16 levels).
